messages:
priya_sales: quick pass — handing Acera Health to CS. closed POC today. main asks: Okta SSO, private/on‑prem eval (air-gapped option), and a 2‑week elevated support window. flagged renewal risk: they want annual with a performance clause if 95th p95 token latency >300ms. sending SAML metadata + billing note to sam.
sam_cs: thanks — i'll own onboarding. kickoff call proposed Mon 10am PST. need Okta metadata + primary infra contact (email). can someone own the private deploy validation? @lin_eng?
lin_eng: i'll take private deploy validation. need their hardware spec + model artifacts (weights + config). also confirm sequence length and typical traffic shape (peaks/steady). pinging ops for a staging node.
ops-bot: new infra request created: req-8763. provisioning 1x A40-staging node in staging-corp-vpc. ETA ~4h. Logs: https://infra.redwood/reqlog/8763 :gear:
jordan_support: i'll shadow during the 2-week window and set up alerts. sam — please get us their Sentry/org access and prometheus scrape target or Grafana dashboard. will create a runbook for incident handoff.
priya_sales: infra contact is devops@acera.com (Marta). sending SAML metadata now. note: they need a demo of failover routing across regions; that may affect cost.
sam_cs: action list so we don't lose anything: 1) kickoff call Mon 10am (owner: sam_cs) 2) collect SAML + devops contact (owner: priya_sales) 3) staging node + deploy validation (owner: lin_eng / ops-bot) 4) set up monitoring + runbook (owner: jordan_support) 5) legal/renewal clause flagged (owner: priya_sales) 6) create support ticket (owner: sam_cs).
lin_eng: quick config note — for private eval recommend starting with quantized fp16 profile and sequence_len cap 1024. if they send longer contexts we need to size KV cache memory. sample deploy snippet for ops:

```
model_variant: redwood-v1-quant
gpu: a40
kv_cache_mb: 1200
batching: auto
network: private-vpc
```
sam_cs: creating internal ticket SR-4321 and adding owners + links to SAML + PCI notes. tagging priority: high for first 72h.
jordan_support: i'll draft the runbook template and drop it in the kickoff doc. include alert thresholds: p95 tokens >300ms, error rate >1% sustained 5m.
priya_sales: FYI negotiated pricing: annual commit, 12-month term, with a 6% risk holdback if performance SLAs violated in first 30 days. finance ok to proceed but CS should track SLA tests during onboarding.
sam_cs: noted. i'll add SLA test matrix to the kickoff agenda and assign daily smoke tests for week 1. @lin_eng any objections?
lin_eng: no objections. i'll run a perf sweep post-deploy and share baseline numbers.
ops-bot: provisioning updated: req-8763 -> node ready. ssh: jump-staging.acera/redwood-test (ops ticket link: https://infra.redwood/req/8763). :white_check_mark:
sam_cs: great — next steps: 1) priya share SAML + Marta contact (ASAP) 2) sam to send calendar invite for kickoff 3) lin to validate deploy once node is up 4) jordan to prep runbook + alerts 5) ops to confirm networking/egress firewall rules. i'll update SR-4321 and close this thread when kickoff scheduled.
priya_sales: sharing SAML now and cc'ing Marta. thanks team :thumbsup:
